title: Separate conditional mean error from native observation noise
statement: At independently prepared centers take D=g(X+G)-b(X)-A G and independent D1,D2. The paired plus/minus energies satisfy E||Y+||^2=2R_T^2+S_T and E||Y-||^2=S_T. Gaussian preparation and one-sided concentration acquire a simultaneous residual/noise event without replacing average noise by a uniform covariance promise.

requires: Original whole-vector values g(z), supplied global Lip(g)<=L<1 and sigma>0
Frozen executable candidate b with justified global Lip(b)<=beta<1, bounded noise-control A, actual finite Gaussian preparation and independent validation
provides: A consequence-specific residual radius and integrated noise bound from native values
assumptions: All validation centers are independently prepared after freezing training
A norm-error warranty for source/candidate evaluation is supplied, not acquired by query counts
costs: Training, fresh validation, b(0), candidate steps and Gaussian preparation; dense matrix/source arithmetic can cost O(d^2)
Every correction query and full vector answer is paid; future schedules are chosen from the acquired record, not production-dependent stopping
contract.units: Euclidean W2 distance per output; d scalar answers per original vector; Gaussian preparations, arithmetic, source calls and conditional failure budgets are separate.
contract.obstruction: Raw residual RMS can hide cancellation that determines the actual mean-law error.

evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: A useful globally qualified candidate is not acquired for every hard source. Conditional output independence does not imply unconditional independence after shared training. False-release control is unconditional over acquisition, not posterior confidence after release. The executed fixture is affine within the candidate class; the nonlinear extension has no new numerical execution. Finite-bit/instrument warranties, rare-event consequences, critical dynamics and broad practical advantage remain separate. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. review.scope: The delivered statements report completed substantive independent internal reviews at their actual scope.
